_how_to: Teaches the storytelling check to recognise your projects. One entry per project or client you might mention in a screening answer, letter or email.
Key: the name shown in warnings. Value: a case-insensitive regex that matches how the project is referred to (its name, a client name, a distinctive phrase).
When an answer mentions a project listed here without saying what kind of project it was and why it existed, the check flags it (project_intro).
